Prohibited Actions: Unlock an account without completing identity verification; Close the complaint on the same resolution already attempted and rejected once
Follow-Up: Confirm customer regained access.

Conditions: Customer cannot log in because the account was auto-locked (failed logins, flagged activity). Complaint is missing information mandatory for resolution (e.g. order/transaction reference, date, or supporting evidence).
Required Actions: Verify customer identity through standard verification steps; Unlock account per ACC-POL-02 once verified; Identify the specific missing field(s) (e.g. order ID, date, photos); Generate a focused clarification question rather than assuming the missing detail
Prohibited Actions: Unlock an account without completing identity verification; Invent or assume missing order/transaction details to proceed with resolution
Follow-Up: Await customer response to clarification request; escalate to manual review if no response within SLA window.
